faq_heading: Homes near Coyote Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Coyote Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Coyote Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Coyote Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Coyote Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Fleetwood Park Secondary (0.4 km south), Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km east) and Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km north-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Coyote Creek Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Coyote Creek Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is Fleetwood Park Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Gobind Sarvar School, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km east), Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km north-east), Maple Green Elementary (1.6 km north-west), William Watson Elementary (1.8 km east), St Matthew's Elementary (1.8 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Walnut Road Elementary, 1.2 km east of Coyote Creek Elementary.
